tasks.label: Parse inline scripts
Parse Base Scripts
tasks.command:
python -c "code = '''import re, pathlib, subprocess
text = pathlib.Path('templates/converter/base.html').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
scripts = re.findall(r'<script[^>]*>(.*?)</script>', text, re.S)
print('Found', len(scripts), 'script blocks')
for i, s in enumerate(scripts):
    p = pathlib.Path(f'tmp_script_{i}.js')
    p.write_text(s, encoding='utf-8')
    r = subprocess.run(['node', '--check', str(p)], capture_output=True, text=True)
    print('BLOCK', i, 'RC', r.returncode)
    if r.stdout: print(r.stdout)
    if r.stderr: print(r.stderr)
    p.unlink(missing_ok=True)
'''; exec(code)"
